subject.title: feat(config): journal every config change with source labels and manual-edit detection

question: May this Phase 2 journal expose non-atomic, potentially duplicate or misordered external-edit records until the planned atomic-journal successor is implemented?
rationale: The answer determines whether the new diagnostic record is an acceptable staged operator feature or whether its correctness boundary must be completed before merge; repository policy treats persistent state and config behavior as maintainer-sensitive.

options.title: Require atomic journaling first
options.body: Hold this PR until classification, append, and snapshot advancement share one authoritative SQLite transaction or equivalent serialization.

options.title: Accept a bounded interim journal
options.body: Merge with the documented ordering limitation only if maintainers accept that records are diagnostic hints rather than a strictly ordered forensic source until the successor lands.

options.title: Narrow to write origins only
options.body: Defer live and offline external-edit detection, retaining only deterministic internal write attribution in this phase.

recommendation.title: Require atomic journaling first
recommendation.body: Hold this PR until classification, append, and snapshot advancement share one authoritative SQLite transaction or equivalent serialization.

likelyOwner.reason: The linked proposal and current branch both place this staged journal design with this contributor, though final product acceptance remains a human maintainer decision.
